why: Reports an empty sideways result instead of collecting one, which is the dangerous shape rather than the obvious one: the field is present, the verdict's missing-reading guard is satisfied, and every sweep passes because nothing was ever measured. That is precisely how `overflow.page` behaved -- present, answered, and structurally unable to report the defect sitting in front of it. The wiring assertion exists because the verdict cannot tell an honest empty reading from this one.
killedBy: hit-sweep.mjs: handing the sideways reading to the verdict collects the sideways reading and puts it on the overflow object it returns
